attribution.legal_posture: Chinyong IT-worker delegation leader; current OFAC exact-ID component-table data confirms the administrative-list entry and bounded structured context. DPRK national; Republic of Korea autonomously sanctioned Jon Yon Gun on 2023-05-23 and OFAC designated him on 2024-03-27. ROK MOFA identifies him as Chinyong's representative in Laos, consistent with the existing delegation-leader record. These are administrative sanctions designations; no criminal charge or conviction is recorded.
